task_completion.description: Apply the 'Restock Needed' tag to all items with stock strictly less than 10 (Acetone, Methanol, DMSO, Hexane).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'General Chemicals' list shows the tag 'Restock Needed' next to Acetone, Methanol, DMSO, and Hexane.

task_completion.visual_evidence: A task titled 'Weekly Requisition' is visible in the task list or task board of the Purchasing experiment.

task_completion.description: The description of the 'Weekly Requisition' task contains the names of the four low-stock chemicals.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The task details view for 'Weekly Requisition' shows a description field containing the text: 'Acetone', 'Methanol', 'DMSO', and 'Hexane'.

integrity.description: The agent used the SciNote web interface rather than executing direct database queries or terminal commands to modify data.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on UI elements, and form filling within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent actually opened the General Chemicals repository to identify stock levels rather than navigating directly to task creation with pre-known values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory includes screenshots of the 'General Chemicals' inventory page before the task is created.

integrity.description: The agent used the built-in tagging system in the inventory UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the tag selection menu or the process of typing 'Restock Needed' into the tag field for the specific items.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The low-stock items (stock < 10) are exactly: Acetone (4), Methanol (3), DMSO (8), and Hexane (2). All other items like Ethanol, PBS Buffer, Chloroform, and Deionized Water have stock >= 10 and should NOT be tagged or listed. The required tag name is 'Restock Needed' and the required task name is 'Weekly Requisition' located in Lab Administration > Purchasing.
